info.name: SendRec integration
info.summary: Integration with the SendRec self-hosted video platform
info.description:
SendRec integration provides link previews, Smart Picker, and unified search for your self-hosted SendRec instance within Nextcloud.
Configure your SendRec instance URL in the admin settings and get rich link previews when SendRec watch URLs are pasted in Talk, Text, or Deck.
info.author: SendRec
